description: This file implements a file-based storage provider for Orleans grains, including a provider class 'OrleansFileStorage' and an internal data manager class 'GrainStateFileDataManager' that handles file system I/O operations for grain state persistence.

classes.name: OrleansFileStorage
classes.description: A storage provider implementation for Orleans that stores grain state data in files within a specified directory.

methods.name: OrleansFileStorage
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the storage provider with the root directory path, creating a data manager instance.

classes.name: GrainStateFileDataManager
classes.description: An internal class that handles file system operations (read, write, delete) for grain state data, implementing the IJSONStateDataManager interface.

methods.name: GrainStateFileDataManager
methods.description: Initializes the data manager with a directory path, creating the directory if it does not exist.

methods.name: Delete
methods.description: Deletes the file associated with a specific grain state identified by collection name and key.

methods.name: Read
methods.description: Reads the grain state data from the corresponding file asynchronously.

methods.name: Write
methods.description: Writes grain state data to the corresponding file asynchronously.

methods.name: GetStorageFilePath
methods.description: Generates the file path for storing the data based on collection name and key.
